answer_1.quote: The task aims to automatically generate a summary of the most relevant works ... we target on the abstractive related work generation task ... we propose a Relation-aware Related work Generator (RRG)
answer_1.outputs: Generated abstractive related work sections (paragraphs) summarizing multiple cited papers

answer_2.quote: We evaluate summarization quality using ROUGE F1. We report unigram and bigram overlap (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2) ... and the longest common subsequence (ROUGE-L)

answer_4.quote: We also assessed the generated results by eliciting human judgments on 30 randomly selected test instances ... conducted on the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform ... participants evaluated related works ... rating score ranges from 1 to 3, with 3 being the best
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered questions about key information and rated the generated related works on informativeness, coherence, and succinctness
